35 distinct recipes form 30 groups of near-identical settings (every input within 0.05 of its range). Each group is held out together, so a held-out run never has a near-twin in training. Replicates recorded as run fall in the same group; the replicate noise model still counts exact matches only.

verdict.headline: The model put your past runs in the right order, but 35 runs in 4 groups are too few to be sure, so treat its suggestions as ideas to test.

ordering.plain: The model put past runs it had not seen in the right order most of the time.

range_width.plain: The likely range is too narrow: fewer results land inside it than it promises.

reasons.plain: The sheet has 4 groups of runs; Kalos needs at least 8 before it calls the model reliable.

verdict.rule: Refused: no held-out score, fewer than 3 groups of runs, or the upper end of the score's 95% interval at or below 0. Reliable: score at or above the floor, the lower end of its 95% interval above 0, at least 20 runs and 8 groups of runs. Not yet: everything else.
